mapper.select: SELECT id, assistant_message_id, call_id, call_index, tool_name, arguments_json, status, result_json, result_payload_version, attempt_count, lease_token, lease_until, revision, created_at, started_at, finished_at, updated_at FROM tool_execution WHERE assistant_message_id = #{assistantMessageId} ORDER BY call_index ASC

SELECT tool_execution.id, tool_execution.assistant_message_id, tool_execution.call_id, tool_execution.call_index, tool_execution.tool_name, tool_execution.arguments_json, tool_execution.status, tool_execution.result_json, tool_execution.result_payload_version, tool_execution.attempt_count, tool_execution.lease_token, tool_execution.lease_until, tool_execution.revision, tool_execution.created_at, tool_execution.started_at, tool_execution.finished_at, tool_execution.updated_at FROM tool_execution INNER JOIN session_message ON session_message.id = tool_execution.assistant_message_id WHERE session_message.session_id = #{sessionId} AND session_message.message_type = 'ASSISTANT' AND session_message.sequence_no > #{afterSequence} ORDER BY session_message.sequence_no ASC, tool_execution.call_index ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE tool_execution SET status = 'RUNNING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, lease_token = #{leaseToken}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, revision = revision + 1, started_at = #{startedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND revision = #{revision} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE tool_execution SET status = #{status}, result_json = #{resultJson}, result_payload_version = #{resultPayloadVersion}, lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, revision = revision + 1, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND revision = #{revision} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND #{status} IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'UNKNOWN')

UPDATE tool_execution SET status = 'UNKNOWN', result_json = #{resultJson}, result_payload_version = #{resultPayloadVersion}, lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, revision = revision + 1, finished_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until <= #{now}
